mapper.select: select * from notify_outbox where status in ('READY', 'PROCESSING') and available_at <= #{now} and (next_attempt_at is null or next_attempt_at <= #{now}) and (lease_until is null or lease_until <= #{now}) order by outbox_id limit #{limit} for update skip locked
mapper.update: update notify_outbox set attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_error_code = 'IN_APP_ATTEMPT_RESERVED', last_error_message = null where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = 'PROCESSING' and lease_owner = #{owner} and lease_token = #{token} and lease_until > utc_timestamp(6) and attempt_count < max_attempts and (last_error_code is null or last_error_code <> 'IN_APP_ATTEMPT_RESERVED')

update notify_outbox set lease_until = timestampadd(second, 60, utc_timestamp(6)) where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = 'PROCESSING' and lease_owner = #{owner} and lease_token = #{token} and lease_until > utc_timestamp(6)

update notify_outbox set status = #{status}, attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, lease_owner = null, lease_token = null, lease_until = null where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = 'PROCESSING' and lease_owner = #{owner} and lease_token = #{token} and lease_until > utc_timestamp(6)

update notify_outbox set status = 'READY', available_at = #{now}, attempt_count = 0, next_attempt_at = #{now}, lease_owner = null, lease_token = null, lease_until = null, last_error_code = null, last_error_message = null where delivery_id = #{deliveryId} and status in ('WAITING_RECEIPT', 'DEAD_LETTER') order by outbox_id desc limit 1
